items.question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who overperformed their xG by the most (goals minus xG)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals, ROUND(SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS xg, ROUND(SUM(pss.goals_pss) - SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS overperformance FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' AND s.competition_id = 1 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(pss.goals_pss) >= 10 ORDER BY overperformance DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1
items.notes: ENG-PL re-scoped (competition_id=1) on the multi-league DB.

items.question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who underperformed their xG by the most (xG minus goals)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals, ROUND(SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS xg, ROUND(SUM(pss.xg_pss) - SUM(pss.goals_pss),2) AS underperformance FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' AND s.competition_id = 1 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(pss.goals_pss) >= 10 ORDER BY underperformance DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1
items.notes: ENG-PL re-scoped (competition_id=1) on the multi-league DB.

items.question: Among players with at least 15 xG in 2024-2025, who had the highest goals-to-xG ratio?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals, ROUND(SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS xg, ROUND(SUM(pss.goals_pss)/NULLIF(SUM(pss.xg_pss),0),3) AS goals_per_xg FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' AND s.competition_id = 1 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(pss.xg_pss) >= 15 ORDER BY goals_per_xg DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1
items.notes: ENG-PL re-scoped (competition_id=1) on the multi-league DB.

items.question: What are the five largest transfer fees paid by a Premier League club (incoming transfers) in the data?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, MAX(tr.to_team) AS to_team, tr.season, tr.transfer_fee FROM player_transfers tr JOIN players p ON p.player_id=tr.player_id WHERE tr.to_team IN (SELECT DISTINCT t.team_name FROM teams t JOIN team_season_standings st2 ON st2.team_id = t.team_id JOIN seasons s2 ON s2.season_id = st2.season_id WHERE s2.competition_id = 1) AND tr.transfer_fee IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, tr.season, tr.transfer_fee ORDER BY tr.transfer_fee DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 5
items.notes: ENG-PL re-scoped (competition_id=1) on the multi-league DB.
